content: Pↄl anà Banabasi u Ikↄnyum
U Ikↄnyum Pↄl anà Banabasi bàbilà sye u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa bàlↄɔŋà. Abun, un'kàbɔ a Ayudà anà Angԑlԑki basi làkwikilà.
Wԑԑ Ayudà bàtön an'lↄↄŋ, waa bàsiinà baar mpa abà Ayudà mutɔŋ mpem ambe akà atɔŋ.
Itàkal abun, ba kwo bàkäl ilä mbↄↄn bàmulɔŋ a uyɔl ntɔn làkwikilà aba akà Mwol. Nde kapԑ ikɔ̈b mukyer impà anà idiim anà mutà imbäl u ndaa a kab angway ande.
Wԑԑ un'sԑŋ a bul waa kàkaabà: amwԑy bàbü a Ayudà, bumwԑy bàbü a Antööm.
Baar mpa abà Ayudà anà Ayudà anà amfum aba, ba bàbön mumԑɛy ba nkwaaŋ anà mukam ba in'kul.
Pa bàyöb ba ndaa ayi, ba bàkyer akàyee, waa bàkyen ntsü a Likayɔni, Listre, Dԑrbԑ anà Likↄnya anà an'bul a tsütsü.
Akun sye, ba bàkäl mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ.
Pↄl anà Banabasi u Listre
U Listre kàkäl anà ŋàkwɛkà mwԑy, nde kàkäl ikar, sԑmà mböör ande, nde kàsàkyà anki dwaan.
Ilä mwɛy nde kàkäl mulab ndaa kàlɔɔŋà Pↄl. Pↄl kun'paam mii, waa kàmԑn naa mbuur awà kàkäl anà làkwikilà ntɔn nde ukɔↄrà.
Apan, nde kàtɛn a nde u ndaa a ngwal naa: « Mbarà, kal aŋàtsim unsà in'kↄl angye! » Mbuur awà waa kàfumà, waa kàkyen.
Mpal bàmԑn in'sԑŋ ndaa kàkyer Pↄl, ba bàsi in'kwԑŋ kà Ilikↄnya, waa bàtɛn naa: « Bànzam ban'bulà baar, waa ban'yàtyà mper akà bi. »
Ba bàpԑ Banabasi ikↄb a « Zösi » Pↄl bun'pԑ ikↄb a « Ɛrmԑsi » ntↄn ndaa yanswà yàkäl anà nde.
Ndwà a nzam a ngaŋ a Zösi yàkäl u nswɛŋ a bul. Nde kàtwääl in'dim a ngɔɔmà anà in'siŋ a iful u minàmbwo a ndwà ayi ntɔn nde kàkwen naa nde anà un'sɛŋ, ba bàpɛ ibɔɔn.
Wԑԑ mpal bàwem Antööm ndaa ayi, ba bàkaam ipfԑy aba, waa bàkyen u ntiin ntsü kàkäl un'sԑŋ a baar, bàmusà in'kwɛŋ

anà mutɛn naa: « Abaal, ntↄn nkye lan'kyer bԑ indiir a tub abi? Làyöb naa bi sye, bi ibà baar asànaa bԑ. Ndaa Aŋàbwaŋ ikàlakyään bi yà naa bԑ làwԑy itԑk, wԑԑ bԑ làyi akà Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈ awà kàkyer du, mԑԑn, ngyäl a kölàköl anà indiir byanswà abyà uboo.
U nkööl yàlyaaŋ, nde kàwԑy in'sԑŋ myanswà mulab ndaa aba ŋakwo.
Itàkal abà, nde kàkɔ̈ɔ̈n anki mutà imbäl a ubwaŋ ande, mukàlapà fà du, mbul anà mbɛŋ kà an'paŋà a bya, mukàlapà isaa anà muyööl mpem abԑ a un'sak. »
Wԑԑ itàkal bàtԑn ba ndaa ayi, yàkäl mpay antööm mutsuŋ un'sԑŋ a baar mukɔɔn akapà ibↄↄn.

Apan, Ayudà bàfü Antyↄsha anà Ikↄn, ba bàsi muküünà akà un'sɛŋ a baar. Un'sɛŋ a baar awà kàkyey an'kyän aba, waa bàtԑ Pↄl in'kul ntↄn mukun'dwa. Ungö ba bàkun'wɔm u nsà a bul. Ba bàsii naa nde kan'kwà.
Wԑԑ mpal bàkàköŋ alɔŋki umbil a Pↄl, laa kàmbarà nde, kàbilà nde uboo a bul. Taaŋtyà, ba bàkyen Dԑrbԑ anà Banabasi.
Mfurà Antyↄsha a Siri
Ungö bàlↄŋ ba baar Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ u bul alà anà baar mbↄↄn bàbulà ba alↄŋki, ba bàfurà Listre, Ikↄn anà Antyↄsha.
Ba bàpԑɛ alɔŋki ngwal anà bàlɔ̈ɔ̈mà naa ba bàsi muküünà u làkwikilà anà mutɛn naa: « Ilↄↄmà naa bi itwab atàman mpay mbↄↄn mubilà kà imwol a Nzam. »
Ba bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l andweer kà Ikööŋ imwԑy imwɛy. Ungö muyamà anà mukin, ba bapԑ kà an'kↄↄ a Mwol awà bàsi ba làkwikilà.
Ungö apan, ba bàsoonà Pisidi mukyà Pamfili.
Ungö mulɔŋ Ndaa u Pԑrzԑ, ba bàtyà Atalya.
Akun, ba bàwԑl an'swà, waa bàkyen Antyↄsha, ikal akyà basi u kab a ngway a Nzam ntɔn isal bàkyer ba.
Mpal bàtöl ba, ba bàbel Ikööŋ, bàkyään ndaa yanswà kàkyer Nzam akà ba, anà kaduub nde sye mbwo a làkwikilà akà baar mpa abà Ayudà.
Abun, ba bàkäl ilä mbↄↄn anà alɔŋki.
